attempts.text:
**The window starts on a three-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `yibF`, `selA` and `selB`, are carried by 97 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 1% of calls. The model names them in 97 to 99% of calls, fewest at `selA`, and hesitates most at `yibF`, 0.74 bits.

**Then the graph opens.** Column 3 is a fork, in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls, and column 4 is a spine, `aldB`, in 94%. Columns 5 to 19 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 59 to 95% of calls, where the model names 82 to 97% of genes. It hesitates most at column 5, 0.94 bits, a hypothetical protein. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 10 to 12, carried by 33 to 35% of chromosomes.

**A long spine follows.** Columns 20 to 35, `ysaA` to `glyS` through the `xyl` genes, [[xylose transport and breakdown]], are carried by 93 to 97% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 25% of calls, and named in 90 to 98%. Column 36 is a variable column, an IS3 family transposase, in a region of plasticity in 2% of calls, where the model hesitates 0.70 bits.

**The `bcs` genes sit in plasticity.** Columns 57 to 64, `bcsG` to `bcsZ`, [[cellulose biosynthesis]], are variable or spine columns, in a region of plasticity in 65 to 81% of calls, named in 84 to 93%. Columns 65 to 72, `bcsC` to `yhjE`, are a spine, in a region of plasticity in 7 to 53% of calls, named in 93 to 95%.

**The window ends on forks.** Columns 73 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 5% of calls, named in 85 to 94%, fewest at column 79, `gadX`, carried by 57% of chromosomes. Across the window the model names 92% of genes at 0.26 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.42 against 0.19 bits, and names fewer, 90% against 94%.

label: yibF
facts:
WINDOW: the yibF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yibF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 118 to 197 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yibF once); 43,036 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,923 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; shell 12,026 calls, named 86%, 0.49 bits; cloud 87 calls, named 14%, 1.73 bits. Outside an RGP 29,011 calls, named 94%, 0.19 bits; inside an RGP 14,025 calls, named 90%, 0.42 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 9 fork, 21 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.42 against 0.19 bits) and names fewer genes (90% against 94%); 14,025 of the 43,036 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 5 ("hypothetical protein") 0.94 bits, RGP 94%; column 0 (yibF) 0.74 bits, RGP 0.2%; column 36 ("IS3 family transposase") 0.70 bits, RGP 2%. The 27 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 91%, 0.35 bits on average; the other 53 columns: named 93%, 0.22 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 4 (spine), RGP 94%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0.2-1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 97-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: yibF "glutathione S-transferase N-termina…", selA "L-seryl-tRNA(Sec) selenium transfer…", selB. named 97-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 1 (selA), named 97%; most hesitant at column 0 (yibF), 0.74 bits.
2. column 3 fork: RGP 92%. named 89%; 0.47 bits.
   3: yiaY S 90% "iron-containing alcohol dehydrogena…"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 30%
3. column 4 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 94%. Genes: aldB. named 85%; 0.53 bits.
4. columns 5-19 (15 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 59-95%. named 82-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 5, named 82%, 0.94 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 10-12, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 33-35%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "MFS transporter", "AraC family transcriptional regulator"
   5 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 55%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicA fam…" S 11%, "hypothetical protein" S 11%
   6 fork: yiaW P 72% "DUF3302 domain-containing protein"; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicB fam…" S 11%
   7 variable: yiaV S 69%
   8 variable: yiaU S 65% "LysR family transcriptional regulat…"
   9 variable: yiaT S 66% "MipA/OmpV family protein"
   10 fork: araD S 80%
   11 fork: sgbU S 79%
   12 fork: ulaD S 80%; also yiaM S 10%
   13 fork: lyxK S 75%; also "DUF4862 family protein" S 10%
   columns 14-19 variable, share 70-88%, all S: yiaO "TRAP transporter substrate-binding…" 78%, yiaN "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 79%, yiaM "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 70%, yiaL "YhcH/YjgK/YiaL family protein" 82%, yiaK "Ldh family oxidoreductase" 87%, yiaJ "IclR family transcriptional regulat…" 88%
5. columns 20-35 (16 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 1-25%. Genes: ysaA "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…", avtA, malS, bax, xylR, xylH, xylG, xylF "D-xylose ABC transporter substrate-…", xylA, xylB, yiaB "inner membrane protein YiaB", yiaA "YiaA/YiaB family inner membrane pro…", wecH, ysaB "YsaB family lipoprotein", glyQ, glyS "glycine--tRNA ligase subunit beta". named 90-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35 (glyS), named 90%, 0.30 bits.
6. column 36 variable: RGP 2%. named 90%; 0.70 bits.
   36: "IS3 family transposase" S 59%
7. columns 37-56 (20 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 1-60%. Genes: hokA, ysaE, cspE, yiaG "HTH-type transcriptional regulator", yiaF "DUF3053 domain-containing protein", ghrB, yiaD "OmpA family lipoprotein", bisC, yiaC "N-acetyltransferase", tag, yhjY "autotransporter domain-containing p…", yhjX "MFS transporter", eptB, dppA, dppB, dppC, dppD "oligopeptide/dipeptide ABC transpor…", dppF, yhjV "amino acid permease", ldrD. named 72-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 54 (dppF), named 72%; most hesitant at column 37 (hokA), 0.42 bits.
8. column 57 variable: RGP 67%. named 84%; 0.45 bits.
   57: bcsG S 84% "cellulose biosynthesis protein BcsG"
9. column 58 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 70%. Genes: bcsF. named 87%; 0.41 bits.
10. columns 59-62 (4 columns) variable: RGP 77-81%. named 87-90% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61, named 87%, 0.57 bits.
   59: bcsE S 82%
   60: bcsR S 89%
   61: bcsQ S 80%
   62: bcsA S 85%
11. column 63 spine: share 90%, all S, RGP 73%. Genes: bcsB. named 91%; 0.43 bits.
12. column 64 variable: RGP 65%. named 93%; 0.31 bits.
   64: bcsZ S 89%
13. columns 65-72 (8 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 7-53%. Genes: bcsC, hmsP, dctA, yhjJ "pitrilysin family protein", kdgK, pdeH, yhjG "AsmA family protein", yhjE "MFS transporter". named 93-95% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 70 (pdeH), named 93%; most hesitant at column 65 (bcsC), 0.25 bits.
14. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-5%. named 85-94% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 79, named 85%; most hesitant at column 77, 0.24 bits.
   columns 73-77 variable, share 72-90%, all P: yhjD "YhjD/YihY/BrkB family envelope inte…" 90%, rcdB 86%, yhjB "response regulator transcription fa…" 80%, treF 78%, ccp 72%
   78 fork: gadA P 67%; also mdtE P 25%, gadE P 15%
   79 fork: gadX P 57%; also gadW P 43%, mdtF P 33%, "hypothetical protein" P 19%
